name: 37127 · Murfreesboro, TN
findings: ZIP 37127 (Murfreesboro) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37127 (Murfreesboro) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37127 (Murfreesboro) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 25% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
